defects.source_locator: MSVV07AdWords.txt:713-731 and 777-819, Theorem 8 dual-suffix formula and simple-proof unspent coefficient
defects.source_claim: The source defines psi_k(i) as the suffix sum of y_j* from j=i through k-1 and prints the closed form 1-(1-1/k)^(k-i+1). The simple proof repeats the same shift by calling (k-i+1)/k precisely the unspent fraction of a type-i bidder whose exact spent fraction is i/k.
defects.status_impact_rationale: Summing the displayed geometric dual witness y_j*=(1/k)(1-1/k)^(k-j-1) from j=i through k-1 gives 1-(1-1/k)^(k-i), not exponent k-i+1. Likewise, exact spent fraction i/k leaves (k-i)/k unspent, not (k-i+1)/k. Both discrepancies are the same O(1/k) finite-index shift and do not change the k-to-infinity competitive-ratio conclusion. Lean proves both corrected identities and concrete k=2 refutations, so this is one minor corrected indexing note rather than a substantial paper caveat.
defects.repair_obligation: Evaluate the finite geometric suffix sum of the displayed y_j* witness and the type-i unspent fraction using the paper's one-indexed bounds, then compare both with the printed +1 expressions.
defects.acceptance_condition: Lean proves the general corrected suffix-sum exponent k-i and corrected unspent coefficient (k-i)/k, and proves concrete finite instances where both printed +1 expressions differ.
defects.resolution_evidence: theorem8_dual_induced_tradeoff_formula proves the corrected suffix identity and theorem8_dual_induced_tradeoff_ne_printed_exponent_at_k2 refutes the printed exponent at k=2,i=1; theorem8_corrected_unspent_fraction_formula proves the corrected coefficient and theorem8_unspent_fraction_ne_printed_at_k2 refutes the printed coefficient at the same finite index.

defects.source_locator: MSVV07AdWords.txt:1191-1220, Appendix three-phase construction and displayed algorithm revenue
defects.source_claim: After 0.4N rounds with m bids of a, 0.1N rounds with m bids of 2a, and a third phase whose queries are all discarded, the source says the algorithm makes 0.62N.
defects.status_impact_rationale: Under the source's stated zero-phase-3 account, the printed phase counts force 0.4N + 0.2N + 0 = 0.6N, not 0.62N. This is a local bookkeeping error. A separate recorded defect corrects the false phase-2 exhaustion claim and derives the true execution value; that value also remains strictly below 1-1/e. Neither defect changes the intended qualitative counterexample, so this is a formalized note rather than a substantial paper caveat.
defects.repair_obligation: Sum the revenue contributions stated for all three phases and compare the corrected factor 3/5 with the paper's 1 - 1/e benchmark.
defects.acceptance_condition: Lean proves the three phase contributions sum to 3N/5, proves this differs from 31N/50 for positive N, and proves 3/5 < 1 - 1/e.
defects.resolution_evidence: appendix_highest_bid_phase_total_eq_three_fifths proves the source's zero-phase-3 contributions total 3N/5; appendix_highest_bid_phase_total_ne_printed_062 refutes 31N/50 for positive N; appendix_three_fifths_lt_msvv_ratio proves the numerical strict comparison. The state-derived execution and its true value are covered by the separate phase-3 residual defect.

defects.source_locator: MSVV07AdWords.txt:1191-1220, Appendix phase-2 exhaustion, phase-3 discard, and algorithm factor
defects.source_claim: The source says bidders 0.5N+1 through N have spent all their money after phase 2, so every phase-3 query is discarded, and uses that execution to claim algorithm revenue 0.62N.
defects.status_impact_rationale: In the small-bids fluid limit, a tail bidder spends log(9/5) in phase 1 and 2/5 in phase 2, leaving the positive residual 3/5-log(9/5). The algorithm therefore serves positive phase-3 mass and has true normalized value 9/10-(1/2)log(9/5), rather than either printed 0.62 or the zero-phase-3 bookkeeping total 0.6. Lean proves the corrected execution feasible, proves its allocation-derived state updates and optimal offline value one, and proves the true factor remains strictly below 1-1/e. The intended qualitative conclusion is unchanged, so this is an ordinary formalized note, not a substantial caveat.
defects.repair_obligation: Derive phase-1 and phase-2 tail spend from the allocation history, compute the remaining phase-3 budget and service, and compare the resulting online/offline ratio with 1-1/e.
defects.acceptance_condition: Lean proves a positive phase-3 residual, a feasible state-derived highest-bid fluid execution that serves it, online value 9/10-(1/2)log(9/5), optimal offline value one, and a strict ratio below 1-1/e.
defects.resolution_evidence: appendix_naive_highest_bid_fluid_rule proves the within-phase choice conditions; appendix_naive_three_phase_fluid_construction proves feasibility, allocation-derived decision states, positive residual, and tail exhaustion after phase 3; appendix_naive_algorithm_true_revenue_formula proves the corrected online value; appendix_optimum_revenue_formula proves offline optimum one; appendix_naive_true_ratio_conclusion proves the true factor is below 1-1/e.
